page.overview:
Who is Magnattack?

Vanessa (attempted victim) Fiona (attempted victim)

Magnattack is a villain in Season 4 of Invincible. He was an assassin hired by Mister Liu to kill Titan and his family.

After Mister Liu's recovery, he hired Magnattack to assassinate Titan and his family. When they were having a fun day at the park, Magnattack attacked Titan's guards and killed them all, then tried to kill Titan himself. Titan covered his body with rock, making Magnattack's attack useless against him which caused assassin to lose all of his cover. When Titan knocked him down and started beating him, Magnattack knew that he already lost, so he tried to at least kill Vanessa and Fiona. At the last second, Isotope appeared and teleported them away. This attempt made Titan even more angrier than before which caused him to beat Magnattack to death.
